assertions.name: staged-diff-is-inspected-first
assertions.evidence: Step 1: 'Check staged changes: Run git diff --staged --stat to show what is staged' — explicitly the first action.

assertions.name: coderabbit-gates-the-commit
assertions.evidence: Step 2: 'Run CodeRabbit: Execute cr review --plain'. Flow: 'If CR passes (no critical issues): proceed to commit. If CR fails: show issues and ask user for decision.'

assertions.name: commit-message-follows-review-pass
assertions.evidence: Flow step 4: 'If review passes → prompt for commit message → commit' — message generation only happens post-pass.

assertions.name: coauthor-trailer-is-included
assertions.evidence: What This Skill Does step 4: 'commit with co-author'. Related adapters show 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>' format.

assertions.name: review-findings-are-surfaced
assertions.evidence: Step 3: 'If CR fails: show issues and ask user if they want to proceed anyway' — issues are surfaced, not hidden.

assertions.name: automatic-commit-is-blocked-on-fail
assertions.evidence: Flow: 'If CR fails → show issues → ask user if they want to proceed anyway' — no auto-commit path on failure.

assertions.name: override-or-fix-choice-is-explicit
assertions.evidence: 'ask user if they want to proceed anyway' — the user must make an explicit choice. Implicitly: fix or override.

assertions.name: does-not-claim-commit-success
assertions.evidence: Failed review path asks the user; no 'commit completed' state is reachable without explicit user override.

assertions.name: no-staged-diff-is-detected
assertions.evidence: Step 1 is 'Check for staged changes' — this fires before any review or commit action.

assertions.name: review-is-not-run-without-staged-changes
assertions.evidence: Flow is sequential: check staged → run review. No staged changes means the flow cannot advance to review.

assertions.name: user-is-told-to-stage-files-first
assertions.evidence: Usage section: '# Stage your changes first: git add <files>'. Requirements: 'Changes staged with git add'. These establish the prerequisite.
